title: I Kind of Lost It

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Listen, I'm in good with the Boards. We're on the same track if you get what I mean. Give me three days and I'll have the Lims. I'll ping you as soon as I have them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, I'm in good with the Boards. We're on the same track if you get what I mean. Give me three days and I'll have the Lims. I'll ping you as soon as I have them.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Seriously? Well, fuck you then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously? Well, fuck you then.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Whoo, knew I could bet on you. Damn... I shoulda bet on you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoo, knew I could bet on you. Damn... I shoulda bet on you.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Oh! Hey! Good to see you again. I think. Eh, I'd bet it is. What do you say? Hundred Lims that's you're here to see me out of the goodness of your heart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh! Hey! Good to see you again. I think. Eh, I'd bet it is. What do you say? Hundred Lims that's you're here to see me out of the goodness of your heart.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Hmmm. And that's why I didn't bet. Could feel it. Always get that feeling when things are going south. Speak of... What are you doing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm. And that's why I didn't bet. Could feel it. Always get that feeling when things are going south. Speak of... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Eh, you know, am as good as the Boards will let me be. Bloody greens keeping themselves on time. Those departures are killing me though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, you know, am as good as the Boards will let me be. Bloody greens keeping themselves on time. Those departures are killing me though.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Shima? Masato the Scorpion Shima has you running errands for him? How the living lights did you find him? Who gave you the coin?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shima? Masato the Scorpion Shima has you running errands for him? How the living lights did you find him? Who gave you the coin?

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Masato? Hahaha! You're doing work for someone and you don't even know who they are? Risky when you got businesses to run and an image to keep. I like the way you gamble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Masato? Hahaha! You're doing work for someone and you don't even know who they are? Risky when you got businesses to run and an image to keep. I like the way you gamble.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Eh, it's a story. Started like most, you know, bullied as a kid, aggressive parents, whatever. There was this girl he had a thing for, least that's what the stories say. Anyway, one day, he gets picked on real bad. I mean ass kicked hard.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, it's a story. Started like most, you know, bullied as a kid, aggressive parents, whatever. There was this girl he had a thing for, least that's what the stories say. Anyway, one day, he gets picked on real bad. I mean ass kicked hard.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Apparently that one was bad. Like almost dead, bad. Changed him and shit. But that girl, she was there. She's the one who gave him his first shimmer chip. Custom scorpion and all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apparently that one was bad. Like almost dead, bad. Changed him and shit. But that girl, she was there. She's the one who gave him his first shimmer chip. Custom scorpion and all.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: I don't know. Maybe she had a thing for him too? I'd wager it was something else. You know, if you're interested in taking that bet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Maybe she had a thing for him too? I'd wager it was something else. You know, if you're interested in taking that bet.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: It is if you want to stop listening. Fact is, that gesture gave him a second wind, and that scorpion gave him a new personality. He runs a racket masquerading as a loan shark but that's not what nets him the Lims. See if you can get close enough to find out what's really going on. Oh, and do it without winding up tied to the bottom of an oil rig.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Ha. Yeah, I know those two freak shows. They're like fucking ghosts you know! One of 'em disappears and then POOF! suddenly the other one's there. It's maddening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha. Yeah, I know those two freak shows. They're like fucking ghosts you know! One of 'em disappears and then POOF! suddenly the other one's there. It's maddening.

nodes.speaker: Mizzy Weiss
nodes.text: Ha! Deserved it. Sure. I'd be willing to put a twenty Lim chip on the fact that you stumbled into it? You've had one interaction with the scorpion and are already feeling the venom? Haha. Yeah, you're doing great.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! Deserved it. Sure. I'd be willing to put a twenty Lim chip on the fact that you stumbled into it? You've had one interaction with the scorpion and are already feeling the venom? Haha. Yeah, you're doing great.
